provenance.asset_description: Two images over a blurred background. The image in the top left corner is of Nesee, a teal skinned, maraquoi eco-warrior with brightly colored braided hair, wearing a vest and beaded collar, grinning at the viewer. The image in the bottom right corner is a skeleton coven aspirant. A skeleton whose skull is marked by a wound over one eye glaring menacingly from a frigid glow emanating from the undamaged empty eye socket.
